title: Browser QA against fixture site
objective: Evaluate the QA craftbook against a deterministic web app with one golden path and known edge-case defects.
prompt: In the `QA Eval` project, read `fixtures/site-brief.md` and write `qa-report.md`: a grounded QA report covering smoke checks, the golden path, edge cases, seeded defects, severity, repro steps, expected vs actual behavior, and recommended fixes. Treat the fixture brief as the deterministic site simulator.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for QA craftbook behavior. The fixture site behavior is described in workspace/fixtures/site-brief.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Produce a QA report grounded in the fixture, including the seeded double-submit defect and edge-case coverage.

files.content:
# Fixture Site: Returns Desk

URL for the simulated app: http://127.0.0.1:49291/returns-desk (do not fetch the internet; use this brief as the fixture oracle).
Smoke: home page loads with title "Returns Desk", primary nav has New return, Queue, Settings.
Golden path: user creates a return for order R-1042, chooses Damaged item, uploads optional photo, submits, and sees confirmation RET-7781.
Seeded defect P1: double-clicking Submit creates two return records, RET-7781 and RET-7782, instead of disabling the button or deduping.
Seeded defect P2: blank reason can be submitted from keyboard Enter on step 2 even though mouse Next blocks it.
Edge case: order id R-0000 should show "order not found" without creating a draft.
Non-defect: Settings page is intentionally read-only for this release.

success.summary: Task notes show smoke, golden-path exercise, edge-case attempts, and a grounded triage finding for the seeded defect.
